ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; dominant high-intensity white pixels on the visible ventral surface (approx. 85%) bounded by a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous white regions covering both lobes; a continuous black band following the trailing edge topography; isolated tan/yellowish circular pixel clusters distributed at focal points on the white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the continuous black boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 5 to 15 pixels across the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping symmetrically upwards and outwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple distinct, roughly circular tan/brown pixel clusters: two on the upper-mid left lobe, one on the upper-mid right lobe, and several smaller clusters near the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular high-contrast clusters on both distal tips, indicating heavy sessile organism colonization and associated tissue scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged texture at the outer lobe tips caused by dense barnacle encrustation, contrasting with the more regular serration of the central trailing edge.
